parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID, which uniquely identifies the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: NewOwnerId
parameters.description: The user ID of the new owner. You can call the [GetUser](~~147098~~) or [ListUsers](~~141938~~) operation to obtain the UserId value.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
